quest.title: The Last Step of Testing
quest.description: Ginette's idea seems to work, but she's just one step away...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heya, Ginette! Did you get all the robots we found?

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: I did! Good work, you two.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, we made some new discoveries!

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: You did? Please tell me everything!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You and Paimon tell Ginette about what you witnessed not long ago.

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: The behaviors you described... The robots seemed to like you very much, and thus sent you a message. An invitation to "play together."

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: Now I'm certain — my vision can only be realized through interactions between these robots. The more units we can retrieve, the closer we get to my original plan...

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: Now, they can already communicate with others. All we have to do is find the rest of the robots, and... Yes! I can see my creativity bearing fruit...!

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: Ah! Sorry, I'm getting a bit worked up... I'll still need your help for the rest. Here, I've marked out the next area on the map.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then let's get going! Paimon's just as curious to see where this'll lead!
